claim: Apple's Vietnam supplier count grew from 27 in 2022 to 35 in 2023 -- eight new suppliers added in a single year -- operating 38 factories, concentrated in northern provinces (Bac Ninh, Bac Giang, Hai Phong).
stance_target: manufacturing diversification can move at single-year granularity for supplier onboarding, even if full volume ramp is slower
quoted_support: the number of Apple's suppliers with manufacturing facilities in Vietnam increased from 27 in 2022 to 35 in 2023. This growth has made Vietnam the top destination for the tech giant's suppliers in Southeast Asia and the fourth worldwide.

claim: Tim Cook stated on Apple's Q2 FY2025 earnings call (May 1, 2025) that the majority of Apple products sold in the US were expected to be sourced from India and Vietnam combined, framed explicitly as a tariff-risk offset.
stance_target: India/Vietnam diversification has reached material scale by 2025, though not broken out by device or country

quoted_support: Revealing Apple's Q2 2025 financial statement on 1 May 2025, CEO Tim Cook highlighted that the majority of its products sold in the US were expected to be sourced from India and Vietnam.
numbers: majority of US-sold products from India + Vietnam combined

claim: Desay Group, a China-headquartered Apple/Huawei battery-technology supplier, added a further US$25 million to its existing >US$101 million investment in Bac Ninh, Vietnam in 2025, illustrating incremental (not one-shot) capex deployment.
stance_target: capex velocity for individual Vietnam supplier facilities
